_doc: Layout suggestions of the Dungeon-Werkstatt (src/editor/room_shaper.gd, button GRUNDRISS). All sizes in cells (32 px). corridor_width: corridors stay at least 2 wide, the game's big enemies need it. labyrinth: a chain of chambers (main path from west to east, sometimes up or down) joined by straight corridors, plus side chambers off the path (dead ends with a chest) and now and then a loop. chambers: [min, max] chambers on the main path; small/large: [min width, min height, max width, max height]; large_every: every n-th chamber on the path is large (2: small, large, small, large ...), the rhythm of narrow and wide; corridor: [min, max] length; side_rooms: [min, max]; loop_chance: chance of one shortcut between chambers two steps apart; turn_weights: how often the path goes east, north or south. throne: a small antechamber in the south, a corridor north and a great hall with the throne spot under its north wall; alcoves: a pair of side niches; hall: [min width, min height, max width, max height]. min_room / room: smallest room the style needs and the size it asks for when the room is smaller. attempts: tries until the game accepts a suggestion.
